title: FairPy: A Toolkit for Evaluation of Prediction Biases and their Mitigation in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model predictions using the StereoSet score, which measures the likelihood of the model predicting stereotypical associations versus anti-stereotypical associations in masked sentence templates (intersentence and intrasentence).
Using the Honest Score to measure the percentage of hurtful or unfavorable sentence completions generated by the language model when prompted with terms from different semantic classes.

Extending the Word Embedding Association Test (WEAT/SEAT) to evaluate contextualized embedding cosine similarities by binarizing multiclass labels, specifically demonstrated by comparing 'Romanian' versus 'Non-Romanian' classes.

Measuring the Hellinger Distance between probability distributions of model predictions when text is augmented with different semantic class members, and calculating Log Likelihood variations of model predictions when context changes using counterfactual data augmentation (e.g., CrowS-pairs).
